This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for July 31, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. Trump to meet cabinet at Camp David as Iran war drags on - US politics live. President grapples with finding a resolution to Middle East conflict that has pushed up gasoline prices ahead of vital midterm elections Sign up for the US Breaking News email. This was reported by The Guardian.

2. Trump says 'complete disarmament' of Hamas agreed in Gaza but Israel yet to accept. US president hails breakthrough but Israeli far-right minister says 'only solution' is 'encouraging emigration and destroying Hamas' Middle East crisis - live updates What is Trump's Board of Peace and who is involved? This was reported by The Guardian.

3. Iran war live: IRGC claims attack on Kuwait; Gaza peace deal announced. Iran says attacks in response to US strikes; Hamas says any deal is conditional on Israel's full withdrawal from Gaza. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

4. Her mother said no to a phone. As the world debated social media use, Eman Lulu's phone became a lifeline and a window into Gaza for millions. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

5. Middle East crisis live: Hamas will hand over weapons to new Gaza administration, says official, but deal depends on Israeli withdrawal. Hamas's Ghazi Hamad tells Reuters that it will hand over arms to body established by Trump's Board of Peace Trump claims agreement for 'complete disarmament' of Hamas in Gaza but support uncertain Saudi Arabia prepares sea and possible land offensive against Houthis Al Jazeera reporter Hani Mahmoud has reported the mood in Gaza this morning following news of Hamas's potential disarmament. This was reported by The Guardian.

6. Gaza Board of Peace announces Hamas disarmament agreement: What we know. Under the agreement, Israel would have to withdraw from Gaza. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the July 31, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
